title: Project Coordinator
description:
An established organisation in Bristol is seeking a motivated Project Coordinator to support project managers with delivery schedules, risk tracking, and resource coordination across active programmes. An excellent opportunity for someone with great organisational flair, clear reporting abilities, and a collaborative team mindset.

Working in a hybrid capacity, you will have the flexibility to split your time between the office and home, while playing a central role in the coordination and delivery of key projects across the business. If you are someone who thrives on keeping multiple workstreams on track, communicating clearly with stakeholders, and making sure things get done to the highest standard, this role is for you.

What You Will Be Doing
- Leading the day-to-day coordination of projects from initiation through to successful delivery
- Managing project timelines, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring deadlines are consistently met
- Facilitating project meetings, capturing actions, and holding teams accountable for progress
- Maintaining comprehensive project documentation, risk registers, and status reports
- Acting as a central point of contact between internal teams, senior stakeholders, and external partners
- Proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and blockers - and escalating or resolving them swiftly
- Supporting resource planning, budget tracking, and reporting as required
- Contributing to the continuous improvement of project management processes and ways of working

What We Are Looking For
- Proven experience in a Project Coordinator, Project Manager, or similar delivery-focused role
- Strong understanding of project management methodologies (e.g. Agile, PRINCE2, or similar)
- Exceptional organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple projects
- Confident communicator - able to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership
- Proficient in project management tools such as Jira, Asana, MS Project, or equivalent
- A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable working independently in a hybrid environment
- A relevant project management qualification (e.g. PRINCE2, APM, PMP) is desirable but not essential

What Is On Offer
- 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- A high-profile role with genuine influence over project outcomes and business direction
- Fantastic opportunities to grow within the organisation, with clear pathways for career progression
- Funded training and support for professional development and project management qualifications
- A collaborative, ambitious team culture where your contribution is recognised and rewarded

This organisation is recruiting directly through Consula, their recruitment partner.

description:

From conferences and exhibitions to product launches and corporate events, you'll be involved in bringing a wide variety of events to life - from the initial planning stages right through to being onsite and seeing it all come together.

THE ROLE

This is a varied, fast-paced and hands-on position where you'll be involved in:

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We want someone who brings energy, enthusiasm and a brilliant attitude to work every day!

You'll be:
- Super organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Confident, friendly and a great communicator.
- Highly motivated with a positive, can-do attitude.
- Happy juggling multiple projects and deadlines.
- A real team player who isn't afraid to get stuck in.
- Confident using technology and keen to learn new systems.
- Customer focused and committed to delivering a fantastic service.
- Flexible and willing to travel and work outside normal office hours when events require it.
- Someone who takes initiative, asks questions and enjoys finding solutions.

Previous experience in events, hospitality, administration or customer service would be an advantage, but we're equally interested in finding someone with the right personality, enthusiasm and willingness to learn.

WHY JOIN IN ANY EVENT?

We're a small, friendly and hardworking team with big ambitions!

You'll have the opportunity to work on an exciting range of events, develop your skills, gain valuable industry experience and become an important part of our growing business.

This isn't a job where you'll be doing the same thing every day. One day you could be planning a conference, the next managing registrations for hundreds of delegates, and the next travelling to an event and seeing all your hard work come to life.

It's busy, it's varied, it's rewarding - and we love what we do!

THE DETAILS

Location: Portishead - Office Based

Hours: 37.5 hours per week, with flexibility for event delivery, occasional evenings and travel.

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience.

Opportunity: A varied role with hands-on experience, training and career development within the events industry.

SOUND LIKE YOUR KIND OF JOB?

If you're passionate about events, love working with people and want to join a team where you can make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Come and make it happen with In Any Event UK!

Apply now - send us your CV and tell us why you'd be a great addition to our team.

title: Salesforce & Sales Pipeline Coordinator

Salesforce & Sales Pipeline Coordinator

Bristol - Hybrid, with three office days per week expected

Temporary / Fixed-Term Contract

Immediate start preferred

Adria Solutions is recruiting a Salesforce & Sales Pipeline Coordinator for an established professional services business in Bristol.

This is an urgent opportunity for someone with strong Salesforce experience who enjoys bringing structure to sales activity, improving data accuracy and keeping opportunities moving. You will work closely with the business development team to review pipelines, produce reports and ensure clear actions are followed through.

The business is open to an experienced coordinator or a more senior sales operations professional, with the scope and package reflecting your experience.

The role

Your focus will be the day-to-day coordination of Salesforce and the sales pipeline, providing clear visibility of current opportunities and helping the team maintain momentum.

Responsibilities will include:
- Organising and conducting regular pipeline reviews with salespeople.
- Reviewing opportunity stages, expected close dates, forecasts and next steps.
- Identifying stalled opportunities and establishing what needs to happen to progress them.
- Ensuring Salesforce records are accurate, complete and up to date.
- Producing Salesforce reports to support pipeline reviews and commercial decisions.
- Highlighting missing information, overdue actions and inconsistencies in forecasts.
- Following up with salespeople to ensure agreed actions are completed.
- Supporting consistent use of Salesforce and agreed sales processes.

More experienced candidates will have the opportunity to take greater ownership of reviews, challenge forecasts and strengthen accountability across the team.

About you

You will bring:
- Substantial practical Salesforce experience within sales operations, sales support, pipeline coordination or a similar role.
- Confidence working with opportunity records, sales stages, reports and forecasts.
- A good understanding of how sales pipelines operate and what helps opportunities progress.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The confidence to question incomplete updates and follow up with busy salespeople.
- A proactive approach and the ability to become productive quickly.
- Availability to start at short notice and attend the Bristol office regularly.

Experience in professional or financial services would be useful, although sector experience is not essential. The priority is your ability to use Salesforce confidently and support effective sales activity.

If you have strong Salesforce skills and enjoy keeping sales pipelines accurate, organised and moving forward, apply with your CV and availability.

Provide reception, sign-posting and administrative support for seasonal and/or exceptional public health campaigns such as, but not limited to, mass vaccination clinics. Reception Make appointments for patients attending or calling by telephone, using the computer system, and in accordance with the Practices appointment protocols. Assist patients where required with completion of e-consult forms. Contact patients to make arrangements for appointments and other actions in accordance with instructions of Triage GPs. Receive telephone requests for home visits. Receive general telephone enquiries and transfer callers to other surgery staff as appropriate. Receive requests for repeat prescriptions. Give out letters, reports, or forms to patients attending, and take payments where applicable in accordance with the navigation Standard Operating Procedures. Records & Triage As above Receive overflow of telephone calls and sign-post patients appropriately to practice services in accordance with the navigation Standard Operating Procedures. Process new patient registrations Process repeat prescription requests in accordance with the practice procedure. Processing of GPP workflow and tasks. Respond to requests for results and other clinical information in accordance with practice policy Liaise with GPs and other clinicians using the appropriate message system. Systems Administration & Support Retrieval and provision of information or documents from practice systems or external bodies as required. Assist with the cancellation and rebooking of doctor and other clinician appointment sessions as required and as directed by the Assistant Practice Manager or Care Navigator Service Manager. Liaise directly with hospital personnel, labs and other agencies with regard to medical matters. Liaise directly with patients by telephone or in person with regard to medical and administrative matters. Dignity at Work and Equality Statement We are committed to treating all of our staff and Service Users with dignity and respect. You are responsible for behaving in a way that is consistent with the aims of our Equality and Diversity Policy and the Equality Act (2010). This includes not discriminating unfairly in any area of your work and not bullying, harassing or otherwise intimidating other people. You should recognise and appreciate that people, both colleagues and service users are different and to act in ways that are consistent with their needs and preferences. You should at all times embody the ethos and values of Air Balloon Surgery and the Care Navigation Team, keeping patients at the heart of everything we do. Please see attached job description for more information.

title: Medical Receptionist / Administrator
description: Are you looking for a new opportunity to develop your skills? We are seeking two enthusiastic and reliable individuals to join our team as a medical receptionist / administrator. We have 44 hours per week available so are looking for two new employees. Successful applicants must be able to work between 8 - 6.30pm. All applicants will be expected to cover a share of extended hours until 8pm and at least one Saturday per year. You must also be able to work across all 3 of our branches (The Chocolate Quarter, Temple House and Saltford). Key Responsibilities: Front Desk: Greet patients and visitors in a courteous and friendly manner. Manage the check-in and check-out process efficiently. Ensure the reception area is tidy and presentable. Telephone Management: Answer and direct phone calls promptly and efficiently. Address inquiries and provide accurate information. Schedule and confirm appointments. Administrative Duties: Maintain patient records and update information as required. Assist with administrative tasks as needed. Customer Service: Address patient concerns and escalate issues as necessary. Provide compassionate support to patients and their families. Ensure patient confidentiality is maintained at all times. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to convey information clearly and concisely. Professionalism: Maintain a professional appearance and demeanor. Handle stressful situations with calm and composure. Compassion: Demonstrate empathy and understanding towards patients. Provide supportive and compassionate care. Kindness towards colleagues. Organisational Skills: Strong multitasking and time management abilities. Attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping. Technical Skills: Proficiency in using office software (e.g., MS Office, appointment scheduling systems). Familiarity with electronic medical records (EMR) systems is a plus. Experience Previous experience in a reception or customer service role is preferred. Experience in a healthcare setting is an advantage. This is a busy role that is very rewarding. Ability to cope under pressure and manage various tasks at once is vital. Team work and kindness towards colleagues is also highly important. Key responsibilities of the role are reception duties, greeting patients and managing the waiting area. General administrative duties are required; answering calls and booking appointments, completing triage forms, dealing with patient queries, registering patients, sending emails, scanning correspondence, booking hospital transport and liaising with other healthcare professionals. This post includes opening and closing the Surgery.
